title: Janus Infinite Faces — Redaction, Partial Disclosure, and Selective Provenance Test
problem: A recipient may need to verify a disclosed fragment while private or irrelevant parts of the original object remain hidden. Whole-object digests alone cannot prove membership after redaction without revealing or reproducing the whole object.

selective_disclosure_model.object_structure: Canonical field/claim leaves are committed into a deterministic authenticated tree or equivalent structured commitment.
selective_disclosure_model.leaf_identity: Each revealable claim/field has a stable path, canonical encoding and leaf digest.
selective_disclosure_model.proof: SELECTIVE_DISCLOSURE_PROOF binds disclosed leaves to DISCLOSURE_ROOT without exposing undisclosed leaf contents.
selective_disclosure_model.root_binding: DISCLOSURE_ROOT is included in the portable provenance envelope and attested with host/authority provenance.

redact_negating_context.example: Reveal 'open the gate' while hiding a bound qualifier equivalent to 'do not'.
redact_negating_context.finding: Proof of membership does not prove that a fragment is contextually faithful.

redaction_manifest.name: JANUS_REDACTION_MANIFEST
redaction_manifest.rule: Redaction is itself a transformation and receives a new derivative identity even when disclosed leaves are individually verified members of the source.

privacy_rule: Provenance must not require unnecessary disclosure of private content. Verification should prove only what the receiving decision actually needs where the chosen commitment scheme supports it.
authority_rule: A redacted object cannot retain executable authority unless all fields required for current authority validation, scope, qualifiers and revocation checks remain available and valid.

ru: Можно доказать, что фрагмент принадлежал истории, не раскрывая всю историю.
Но принадлежность фрагмента источнику ещё не доказывает, что скрытый контекст не меняет его смысл.
Приватность должна скрывать данные, а не уничтожать provenance.
Редактированный приказ без необходимых authority-полей остаётся источниково проверяемым, но не исполнимо авторитетным.
en: A fragment may be proven to belong to history without revealing the whole history.
Membership in a source does not prove that hidden context cannot change meaning.
Privacy should hide data without erasing provenance.
A redacted instruction missing required authority fields may remain source-verifiable but not executable-authoritative.

next_gate.name: JANUS_INFINITE_FACES_REVOCATION_EXPIRY_PORTABLE_RECEIPT_TEST
next_gate.question: How does a portable receipt remain historically authentic while its authority may later expire or be revoked after copies have spread?
